side.name: Education
side.line: I see kids not getting what they need at school.

side.name: Kids' future
side.line: I think kids will have it worse than we did.

why.detail: Someone upset about their local school and someone dreading the world kids will inherit are naming different things, and a person can pick between them without thinking twice. Education is about what kids get at school today; Kids' future is the broader worry that their whole lives will be harder than ours.

current.name: Education
current.line: I see kids not getting what they need at school.

proposed.name: Kids' future
proposed.line: I think kids will have it worse than we did.

side.name: Kids' future
side.line: I think kids will have it worse than we did.

side.name: Unequal chances
side.line: I see kids born in some neighborhoods get far fewer chances than kids born a few miles away.

why.detail: Worrying that every kid will have it worse is not the same complaint as seeing some kids held back by where they started. Kids' future compares one generation with the last; Opportunity compares people born in different places or families at the same time.

side.name: Climate change

why.detail: Many people who fear kids will have it worse are thinking about money and housing rather than the planet, so folding this into climate would lose them. Climate change is one specific cause; Kids' future also covers costs, jobs, housing and the general sense that things are going backward.

side.name: War and conflict

why.detail: Someone worried about break-ins and shootings on their street and someone worried about wars abroad are telling different stories, and nobody would hesitate between the two.
